summary: Gather every worker's output only while KV offload transfers are outstanding
compatibility: No user action required. Connectors other than OffloadingConnector keep gathering every step.
details: KVConnectorBase_V1.requires_all_worker_outputs() (default True) lets a connector skip the all-rank gather on steps with nothing to report.
OffloadingConnector gathers while transfer jobs are outstanding and for two steps after.
Restores single-stream decode with multi-node TP and OffloadingConnector (59.7 to 65.2 tok/s on 4 GB10 nodes over Wi-Fi).
